info.syllabusName: Giao tiếp liên văn hóa (Intercultural Communication)
info.description: This course consists of 8 chapters, presented in 3 main parts, providing students with fundamental concepts of intercultural communication. The course commences by presenting basic notions of communication and intercultural communication (chapters 1, 2, & 3), and then proceeds to analyze the differences of various cultures (chapters 4, 5, & 6). The course concludes with a discussion of verbal and non-verbal communication (chapters 7 & 8).
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the terms and fundamental concepts used in the study of cultural and intercultural communication.

Enhance the intercultural competence in communicating with people from different cultural heritages; solve cultural conflicts, avoid discrimination and prejudice in intercultural communication; and thus communicate successfully in different cultures.
Compare and contrast behaviors, values, religions, beliefs among various cultures.

Understand values and differences of other cultures; thus have proper behaviors and attitudes towards different cultures. Besides, this course helps students overcome cultural barriers; communicative successfully and effectively in different cultural contexts; and more importantly feel desired to do further researches on languages and cultures in the world.
